issue.title: Support for raw aggregation

repository.name: elasticsearch-net
repository.description: This strongly-typed, client library enables working with Elasticsearch. It is the official client maintained and supported by Elastic.

issue.body: I have developed a custom plugin for Elasticsearch suited for my requirements. It has an implementation of custom query. Till now I was able to use Nest as it supported raw queries. Recently, I've implemented a custom aggregation. But I could not find a way to pass a raw aggregation to the `Search<T>` API. Is there a way I can achieve this without having to pass the entire search string (query, filters, aggregations, fields, etc) in raw format?
